test_case.test_name: Package-bound read-only AMDGPURAS version and help interface attestation
test_case.purpose: Prove the approved amdgpuras binary is installed on the intended compatible SUT and that its exact version and complete help interfaces execute successfully without error or RAS state change.
required_package: Approved AMDGPU-RAS package source/version/checksum and expected binary path
Compatible SUT OS/kernel/driver/firmware identity and expected reported version
Secure least-privilege access, evidence storage and sudo authorization for read-only commands
Optional signed equivalence mapping only if project requires long options
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED. Bind target and hash/package provenance; preserve pre-state. Through protected access run exactly `sudo amdgpuras -v` and `sudo amdgpuras -h` once each, capturing command, timestamps, complete stdout/stderr and exit status. Compare version and help identity to the approved BKC. Do not install, clear logs, invoke any help-listed action, guess alternate switches or retry on error.
test_case.expected_result: Both approved short-option commands exit 0, emit complete nonempty parseable version/help output from the approved binary, report the expected version/interface and produce no permission/runtime/incompatibility error or RAS/platform state change.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact target/binary/package identity, exit 0 for both commands, expected version and usable complete help with no error. FAIL on missing/wrong binary/version, nonzero, error/permission/incompatibility, truncated output or state mutation. Missing package/BKC is NOT READY, not FAIL or Pending.
safety_gate: Authorize version/help only; no injection, clear, reset, repair, install or driver action.
Use protected credentials and exact target identity; redact secrets.
Preserve complete output and logs; stop on first nonzero or unexpected behavior.
No alternate-option probing or automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and target OS/kernel/driver/firmware identity
Exact -v and -h command records with complete stdout/stderr/exit/timestamps
test_case.recovery: On absent binary, nonzero, permission, compatibility or unexpected behavior, stop without trying alternate options or installing/changing anything. Preserve evidence and return to package/owner remediation; no RAS state recovery should be needed for approved reads.
